projects.name: Ducktop2 | Custom 16-inch laptop
bullets: Designing an eight-layer center motherboard and I/O boards around the LattePanda Mu Ultra, with PCIe NVMe, USB, HDMI, Ethernet, and a separate Wi-Fi/Bluetooth socket.
Working on differential-pair routing, power distribution, battery integration, and mechanical clearances. The complete laptop has not reached powered integration.

projects.name: STM32 development board
bullets: Designed a 24 × 44 mm, four-layer STM32F411 board with USB-C, SPI microSD, 22 GPIO pins, and SWD access.
Prepared schematics, layout, Gerbers, BOM, placement files, and a pinout. Starter firmware builds; assembled-hardware testing is pending.

projects.name: Battery management & charging | Ducktop2 subsystem
bullets: Designed a four-layer, three-cell BMS using a BQ76922 monitor, high-side protection MOSFETs, a four-terminal current shunt, and independent current guards.
Integrating an ISL9241 charger on the center board. Current capacity, fault response, and charging behavior still need hardware qualification.

projects.name: BLDC motor controller
projects.status: PCB routed; not built or powered
bullets: Designed a four-layer STM32G474 controller with a DRV8353S gate driver, six-MOSFET inverter, phase-current sensing, and protection circuitry.
Prepared fabrication files and bring-up firmware. Hall-based control is planned for a 26 V Groschopp gearmotor; commutation and FOC are not implemented.
